name: ripgrep
installation_command: mkdir -p ~/.ark/packages/ripgrep; tmp=$(mktemp -d); url=$(curl -s https://api.github.com/repos/BurntSushi/ripgrep/releases/latest | grep browser_download_url | grep -E 'x86_64.*linux' | head -n1 | cut -d '"' -f4); curl -sL "$url" -o "$tmp/asset.tar.gz"; tar -xzf "$tmp/asset.tar.gz" -C "$tmp"; binpath=$(find "$tmp" -type f -name rg -perm -111 | head -n1); cp "$binpath" ~/.ark/packages/ripgrep/rg; chmod +x ~/.ark/packages/ripgrep/rg; rm -rf "$tmp"

name: text-fun
installation_command: mkdir -p ~/.ark/packages/text-fun; if command -v apt-get >/dev/null 2>&1; then sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y figlet cowsay fortune-mod; elif command -v dnf >/dev/null 2>&1; then sudo dnf install -y figlet cowsay fortune-mod; elif command -v pacman >/dev/null 2>&1; then sudo pacman -Syu --noconfirm figlet cowsay fortune-mod; elif command -v apk >/dev/null 2>&1; then sudo apk add --no-cache figlet cowsay fortune-mod; else echo "No supported package manager found; install figlet/cowsay/fortune manually" >&2; fi
